canonical_term: Lineage II: Aden North American launch
definition: The selected North American Lineage II Aden service, officially announced to open at 9:00 AM PDT on 11 August 2021.
cultural_caution: A title-, region-, and date-specific service launch, not all Lineage II products or any other Lineage title/region.

supports: Aden service and North American launch-time boundary

definition: A player-selectable Aden launch class limited in the notes to male Human, male Elf, and male Dark Elf characters; its lore introduction names the Knights of Death as a secret group opposing Valakas.
cultural_caution: A selectable class and generic historical group context, not an individual named character or a claim that all players share the same history.

citations.locator: Two New Classes, Death Knight Class
supports: Death Knight player-class availability and Knights of Death/Valakas lore label

definition: A new Aden launch player class for the Sylph race, described as a hybrid combat style using melee/ranged patterns and high maneuverability.
cultural_caution: A class/mechanics description, not a named NPC or a fixed identity of any player-created character.

citations.locator: Two New Classes, Storm Blaster Class
supports: Storm Blaster class, Sylph relation, and described combat pattern

definition: One of the seven playable Aden-server races, described as an Ertheia race created by Einhasad with the Soul of Wind and as worshipping Sayha.
cultural_caution: A player race. The terms Einhasad and Sayha occur only as lore labels in the race description and do not justify deity character records in this source pass.

supports: Sylph race, Ertheia/Soul of Wind origin wording, and Sayha worship

definition: The Aden advancement system with up to three player-selected class transfers, branching after the second transfer.
cultural_caution: A player progression/branching system; it does not establish an unchanging class or story path for a character node.

supports: Three transfers and player branch-selection context

definition: The launch field-raid system: timed raid spawns, World Map display/teleport, difficulty categories, and variable drops.
cultural_caution: A system. Named raid/boss entries in its reward table are not character profiles and are not promoted to nodes.

citations.locator: Raid Boss System, Field Raid World Map/Teleport and Raid Rewards
supports: Raid system mechanics and named-boss-label limitation

definition: The launch service's currencies used in systems including recovery and the L2 Coin Shop.
cultural_caution: Currencies/account-state mechanics, not individual artifacts or stable character attributes.

citations.locator: XP Recovery System and L2 Coin Shop sections
supports: Currency uses and server-specific system context

definition: A variable player-character reputation system that distinguishes Chaotic and Lawful status and changes through PvP/PK actions.
cultural_caution: A mutable player state, never a permanent attribute of an absent named individual or a claim about all regional versions.

citations.locator: Check Character Status and Reputation Details/Increase-Decrease sections
supports: Karma/reputation mechanics and mutable player-state context
